title: Admin guidance and clearer navigation for adding products

requirements.summary: Add a concise help/instructions section at the top of the admin Product Management page describing exact steps and required vs optional fields.
acceptanceCriteria: When an admin visits /admin, a visible help/instructions block is shown above the product table/empty state.
The instructions are written in English and explicitly mention which fields are required vs optional.
The instructions mention that Image URL and Affiliate URL must be valid URLs.

file_operations.description: Add a compact “How to add products” instructions block above the existing page header/table/empty state, including: (1) step list (login → open Manage Products (/admin) → click “Add Product” → fill required fields → save), (2) explicit required fields (Product Name, Category, Description, Image URL, Affiliate URL), (3) explicit optional fields (Brand, Price), and (4) a note that Image URL and Affiliate URL must be valid URLs. Keep it visible regardless of loading/empty/table states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Rename the admin header navigation label from “Admin” to “Manage Products” in desktop and mobile menus while keeping the /admin route.
acceptanceCriteria: If the user is an admin, the header shows a navigation item labeled “Manage Products” that navigates to /admin.
The same “Manage Products” label appears in the mobile menu for admins.

file_operations.description: Update admin-only navigation labels from “Admin” to “Manage Products” for both desktop and mobile menus, while preserving navigation to /admin. Continue using role-based access control to show the link only for admins (authorization component capability: role-based access control/role detection). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only empty-state CTA on category pages to navigate directly to /admin when the category has no products.
acceptanceCriteria: On /fashion, /jewelry, and /luxury, if there are zero products in that category and the viewer is an admin, the empty state includes a button that navigates to /admin.
If the viewer is not an admin, the category empty state remains informational only (no admin CTA).

file_operations.description: Enhance the empty state rendering to detect admin users and, only when the current category has zero products and the viewer is an admin, show a secondary CTA (e.g., a Button) that navigates to /admin. Keep the existing informational empty state unchanged for non-admin viewers. Use the existing role-based access control hooks/data already present in the app (authorization component capability: role-based access control/role detection). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
